Till it's not required as functionality in application, this requirement or requirements, if we keep them, belong to V1.8.

edit: Actually those requirements makes sense and belong where they are.

We checked it from end-user perspective, and it is not clearly required to provide mentioned functionalities via user-interface.

But if user makes call to helpdesk (as an example), then in the application must be present a method or procedure to export and/or delete user-related data.
Till it's not required as functionality in application, this requirement or requirements, if we keep them, belong to V1.8.
